title: War Department asks FBI to clear GeBauer

tellings.quote: the War Department is asking the FBI to clear him. So, I think he worked on some kind of topshelf project.

plain: Around 1942 and 1943, the War Department, as the US military's home department was then called, is said to have asked the FBI under J. Edgar Hoover to give security clearance to a man named Leo Gaybower, also spelled GeBauer. A crash researcher named Scott Ramsey says he found this in Gaybower's FBI file, and takes it to mean the man "worked on some kind of topshelf project." It is told to show Gaybower had serious secret wartime work.
